name: X API
tagline: Official X (Twitter) platform API for posts, users, search, and engagement.
description: X API (formerly Twitter API) provides programmatic access to posts, user profiles, timelines, search, direct messages, media, and engagement data on X. Developers authenticate with OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens, call REST endpoints under api.x.com, and choose Free, Basic, Pro, or Enterprise tiers depending on volume and features.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (user context) or OAuth 2.0 App-Only Bearer Token; also OAuth 1.0a. Create a Project/App in the X Developer Portal; use Authorization: Bearer YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN or OAuth signed requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier exists with very low write/read caps (e.g. limited posts/month and read requests); exact published numbers change — verify on developer.x.com pricing. Pay-as-you-go Basic/Pro for higher volume.
pricing.paid_plans: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers via developer.x.com; pricing and included request quotas vary by product (posts, search, etc.).

rate_limits: Per-endpoint and per-app/user limits vary by product tier; published in X API rate-limit docs (e.g. many v2 read endpoints ~15–900 req/15 min depending on endpoint and auth).
use_cases: fetch a user profile by username
post a tweet/status on behalf of a user
search recent public posts by keyword
get a user’s recent timeline posts
lookup engagement metrics for a post
stream or poll mentions of a brand account
